correctness.rationale: Under smooth complex K3 double six-line configuration and ten distinct pencil collision directions, the two blown-up base points give a sectioned genus-two fibration Y with rho(Y)=rho(X)+2. Its vertical/section lattice T has generators section, fiber, ten pair-fiber nonidentity (-2) components and a six-dimensional central star, hence rank 18; star determinant 16 and NS(Y)/T identifies J(C)(C(t)) as an abstract finitely generated group, free rank rho(X)-16. The ordered five moving branch points define the A4 discriminant line; affine Lefschetz surjection onto pure braid P5 and the four squared transvections along a unimodular H1 basis force any invariant n-torsion class to satisfy 2w=0. Six rational Weierstrass points supply all 16 J[2], so torsion (Z/2)^4 for every admissible Picard jump. Independent exact star determinant 16, unimodularity, ten distinct directions and finite modular checks corroborate necessary arithmetic, not the geometric global input. Generic rho16 and conic-tangent rho17 use published Picard numbers.
